build_colbert_model_bert: build a ColBERT model with BERT backbone for per-token embedding retrieval
build_colbert_model_modernbert: build a ColBERT model with ModernBERT backbone for retrieval and reranking
build_colbert_model_jina_roberta: build a ColBERT model with Jina XLM-RoBERTa backbone for multilingual retrieval
build_colbert_model_lfm2: build a ColBERT model with LFM2 hybrid backbone for retrieval with SSM layers
init_colbert_components: initialize ColBERT projection layer with hidden size, output dimension and data type
build_colbert_linear: build the ColBERT linear projection layer from hidden size to ColBERT dimension
build_colbert_pooler: build a token-embedding pooler with optional ColBERT linear projector
load_colbert_weights: separate and load ColBERT projection weights from checkpoint weight pairs
get_colbert_dim_from_config: extract ColBERT dimension from a HuggingFace config checking colbert_dim, dim, projection_dim
